name: EraX-VL-7B-V1.5
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct (config.json max_position_embeddings 32768). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-31. A Vietnamese/document-focused VLM fine-tune of Qwen/Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct (8.291B). Evidence is thin: one benchmark, VI-MTVQA, 47.2 vs the base's 30.0. VI-MTVQA is the vendor's own multi-type-document VQA benchmark with a public eval repo, so the run is re-runnable, but the card prints no harness, no shot count and no per-subset breakdown, and the base appears as a ROW in a leaderboard that also lists Qwen2-VL 72B (41.6) and the older EraX-VL-7B-V1.0 (37.6). Single-benchmark, self-run, self-defined: recorded as published evidence, not as a general capability claim. Licence Apache-2.0, repo created 2024-11-26. Confidence 0.4.

benchmarks.name: VI-MTVQA
benchmarks.config: Card 'Benchmarks / LeaderBoard' HTML table, single VI-MTVQA column: row 'EraX-VL-7B-V1.5' 47.2 vs row 'Qwen2-VL 7B' 30.0. Base is a ROW, not a column. VI-MTVQA is the vendor's own Vietnamese multi-type-document VQA benchmark, self-run, and the card names no harness or shot count ('you can re-run the benchmark at any time').
